title: Voltpilot MQTT Telemetry Payload
description: Payload published by the Node-RED edge on ems/{tenant_id}/{site_id}/{device_id}/telemetry (QoS1). This is a BINDING contract (architecture section 20 item 8). Topic template and the set of edge<->cloud topics are documented in x-topics below.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number per device for gap detection.

measurements.description: Instantaneous measurements. All fields optional; a device reports what it has.

power_kw.description: Active power at the grid coupling point. Positive = import, negative = export.

soc_pct.description: Battery state of charge in percent.

grid_limit_kw.description: Observed effective §14a EnWG power limit. The grid operator enforces this via its own parallel control device; the EMS only OBSERVES it and optimizes within the released envelope (architecture section 14).
